title: Self-host init finds Docker or Compose unavailable
when: Initializing or protecting a self-host bundle without a working Docker Compose plugin.
need: Init refuses before changing the bundle, names the missing prerequisite and links the official Docker install guide. Install Docker (with Compose) and run yoke self-host init again; Yoke does not install these dependencies.
surface: self-host init stderr and self-host guide prerequisites
review: Candidate regression tests cover absent Docker, unavailable Compose, process errors and timeouts without writes. Released-host proof remains pending.
